# demo function map   format=demo-function-map/1
#
# GENERATED by tools/ghidra/demo_export_maps.java.
# Every function that is no longer FUN_. DATA, not a
# document.
#
#   ADDRESS,SIZE,NAME,SRC,BLOCK
#
# ADDRESS is the entry point, 8 hex digits, no 0x.
# SIZE is the body in bytes, which for a function
# Ghidra split or mis-bounded is the wrong number - a
# cross-check on the database, not an independent fact.
#
# SRC: user is a name we chose. A DOS MZ ships no
# library metadata, so there should be no sdk rows -
# one appearing means an analyser guessed a name.
#
# 1845 function(s) carry an invented name
# - FUN_, thunk_FUN_, caseD_, LAB_ - and are not listed.
